name: issue_benchmark
description: A dataset published by the KSU-HW-SEC group intended for benchmarking automated analysis of issue reports (e.g., classification, triage, or information extraction). It measures model ability to categorize issue text and extract relevant fields or labels used in security/hardware/software issue tracking. The dataset targets downstream tooling and research in automated issue understanding and prioritization.
evaluation_method: accuracy and F1 (for classification and extraction tasks)
reputation: A niche dataset maintained by a university security group with limited but growing use in security/SE research.
